title: Jonathan Graydon — frontend redesign
question: Choose the direction to carry across Home, Projects, Music, and Resume. Every direction preserves your full content and real glass refraction.

options.label: Flight deck
options.thesis: A spatial engineering portfolio with a live optical instrument and an impeccably organized body of work.
options.viewport: An oversized Jonathan Graydon nameplate, a three-dimensional interactive optical field, and a precise software–robotics–music index.
options.risk: The instrument vocabulary must stay legible and avoid decorative fake telemetry.

raised.raise: A continuous, legible project index and disciplined keyboard interactions.
Unmistakable section indexing and deliberate state transitions.
One dominant first-viewport focal point with confident type scale.
Pointer motion must produce a visible, graceful response with a quiet resting state.
Animations share a coherent timeline and remain understandable when paused.

options.label: Optical studio
options.lineage: Optical engineering and contemporary design exhibitions
options.thesis: A confident portfolio built around a sculptural lens that reacts to your pointer and reveals the work through glass.
options.viewport: Huge stacked Jonathan Graydon typography with a floating optical form, a quiet capsule nav, and a full-width project preview strip.
options.risk: Dark glass portfolios are familiar; the interaction and typographic composition must carry the distinction.

options.label: Phosphor transcript
options.thesis: A keyboard-led chronological record of projects and accomplishments.
materials: Green phosphor and continuous monospaced transcript
options.viewport: A keyboard-led chronological record of projects and accomplishments.
options.risk: Technical recognition is strong, but long credentials and music evidence become harder to scan.
options.case: Weaker combined audience identification and product clarity than Flight deck.
options.kept: A continuous, legible project index and disciplined keyboard interactions.

options.label: Destination index
options.thesis: Project and music sections advance as large indexed courses.
options.viewport: Project and music sections advance as large indexed courses.
options.risk: Its transit metaphor competes with the actual engineering evidence.
options.case: Weaker combined audience identification and product clarity than Flight deck.
options.kept: Unmistakable section indexing and deliberate state transitions.

options.label: Duotone performance bill
options.thesis: A typographic nameplate leads into tightly ruled project credits.
materials: Hard shadows and condensed display typography
options.viewport: A typographic nameplate leads into tightly ruled project credits.
options.risk: The cinematic frame identifies performance better than technical work.
options.case: Weaker combined audience identification and product clarity than Flight deck.
options.kept: One dominant first-viewport focal point with confident type scale.

options.label: Evidence in monochrome
options.thesis: Large name and role beside actual project previews, followed by evidence-led sections.
materials: Neutral editorial surfaces and restrained clear glass
options.viewport: Large name and role beside actual project previews, followed by evidence-led sections.
options.risk: Exceptionally clear to recruiters, but quieter than your stated frontend ambition.
options.case: Stronger immediate content clarity; less identifying technical spectacle.
options.kept: Every claim has adjacent, inspectable project evidence.

options.label: Living current
options.thesis: Jonathan’s name sits beside an interactive current field and project index.
materials: Black water and luminous motion trails
options.viewport: Jonathan’s name sits beside an interactive current field and project index.
options.risk: The spectacle risks obscuring the specific technical work.
options.case: Weaker combined audience identification and product clarity than Flight deck.
options.kept: Pointer motion must produce a visible, graceful response with a quiet resting state.

options.label: Mechanical folio
options.thesis: A linked progression reveals software, robotics, and music as distinct chapters.
materials: Cut paper and linked mechanical motion
options.viewport: A linked progression reveals software, robotics, and music as distinct chapters.
options.risk: A handcrafted paper metaphor does not express the requested optical glass.
options.case: Weaker combined audience identification and product clarity than Flight deck.
options.kept: Animations share a coherent timeline and remain understandable when paused.

canonCard.label: Classic technical portfolio
canonCard.thesis: A conventional portfolio layout executed with precise typography, project imagery, and glass navigation.
canonCard.viewport: A two-column introduction followed by a grid of featured projects.
canonCard.risk: Clear and familiar, with less compositional surprise.
